# Credit Loan Risk Assessment Review

This document details critical areas requiring immediate attention following an audit within the Credit & Loans department.

## Key Action Items:

*   Investigate the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Review the default risk based on audit findings.
*   Urgently investigate interest rates.
*   Urgently review the borrower credit score.
*   Urgently optimize interest rates.
